content.value: Select the reinforcing bars for the braced tied column, as shown in figure. The (23) reinforcement will be placed in two faces where the distance from the column edge to the center of the bars is 2.5 in. The rectangular column is bent in single curvature about their strong axis and it has an $\mathbf { \boldsymbol { \mathfrak { I } } } _ { \mathfrak { Y } }$ of 16 ft. Also note that the unfactored dead axial load $\mathsf { P } _ { \mathsf { D } }$ is 120k. If $\mathsf { k } = 0 . 8 0 , f _ { y } = 6 0$ ksi, and $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 4$ ksi.
